input: I want to build open source cysec toolkits. a lot of what currently exists is paid or piecemeal. let's set that up. for devsec. long term project here.
errors: test_devsec fixture-coverage guard failed once (actions-runtime-deprecation had no fixture case); fixed by adding one.
gitops/tests failed twice on derived counts (runs-on README, mirrored tool total); fixed with the named sync scripts.

doc_friction.issue: Comment above DOWNLOADABLE_CLI_FILES says the repository is private; CLAUDE.md says it is public. Cost time deciding whether GitHub links on a page would 404.

`promptctl.py route` with no --track drew research for an owner-named product brief; the 'if the message asks for something specific' rule is right but comes after the command, so it is easy to run route first.

runs-on count was already 2 stale on main; every new-venture PR that adds a workflow trips gitops/tests and has to run sync_readme_counts.py, which CLAUDE.md's checklist does not mention next to sync_tree_counts.py.

deviations.why: Did not make the venture a one-click self-deploy app: a CLI/CI toolkit has nothing to host; the self-deploy equivalent is the SHA-pinned workflow template users copy into their own repo.

Did not fix the one real-looking high finding in .github/workflows/public-surface-check.yml: on inspection it is a false positive (artifact path is outside the workspace), recorded in the toolkit ROADMAP instead.

notes: Owner asked to start a long-term open-source devsec toolkit project. Built ventures/devsec-toolkit wrapping 22 existing check ventures behind one runner (SARIF/JSON/Markdown, config, baselines, bundle, CI template, report-viewer page) plus a six-phase ROADMAP.md that later runs pick up from.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: Surveying ~90 check CLIs, writing a runner with 6 adapters, SARIF/baseline/bundle, tests, page and roadmap: about three engineer-days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
